definitions.explanation: A position or role that is currently unoccupied because a member has left or the position has not yet been filled.

examples.japanese: {欠員|けついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
{欠員|けついん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補充|ほじゅう}する→補充する：25240_hojuusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: We put out a recruitment call to fill the vacancy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{欠員|けついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧おり、⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Vacancies due to resignations keep piling up, increasing the burden on those still working.

notes:
A formal term commonly used in workplace and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠員|けついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a vacancy opens up)
- {欠員|けついん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補充|ほじゅう}する→補充する：25240_hojuusuru⟧ (to fill a vacancy)
- {欠員|けついん}⟦{補充|ほじゅう}→補充：14037_hojuu⟧ (filling a vacancy)
- {欠員|けついん}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧ (recruitment for a vacancy)

USAGE:
Used in formal and business contexts. In casual conversation, people would more likely say ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ (we're short-staffed) or ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いている→空く：11062_aku⟧ (the position is open).
